notes.title: Korean & Simplified Chinese + Daily Deal!
notes.notes: [p]Hello detectives,[/p][p][/p][p]We have two new exciting updates to share! [/p][p][/p][p]First off, Duck Detective now officially supports [b]Korean[/b] and [b]Simplified Chinese![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Translating a mystery full of wordplay is never easy, but we’re thrilled that even more players can now deduckt mysteries in their own language. [/p][p][/p][p]We also want to give a special thank you to everyone who created early [b]fan translations[/b], your hard work helped pave the way for these official localizations and brought Duck Detective to new audiences from the very beginning.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]BUT THERE IS MORE[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]Second, to celebrate this milestone, Duck Detective is part of a [b]Daily Deal[/b] and on sale for [b]20% off[/b], the biggest discount so far! So, if you’ve been waiting to jump in, now is the perfect time to grab a copy.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out this wonderful fanart created by [url="https://www.tumblr.com/sylveoncandy"]SylveonCandy[/url]:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340541/4173bb0e522450e1f81f968e5d0938b13732d646.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to all of you for your continued amazing support, and stay in touch for more updates in the future[/p][p]~Happy Broccoli Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2714620"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Updates Notes for June 7th 2025
notes.notes:
Bug fixes and improvements:

- Interactive points are now more visible in the lake
- It is now easier to get the clue "fake" from the Manager's Hut
- Improved the performance of ghost story, with new failsafe for graphical issues
- Fixed pathfinding issue in the apartment
- Increased maximum audio channels to fix missing voice audio

- IMPORTANT: Fixed critical issue with Mac saves preventing Cloud saves from working
- MAC PLAYERS: Please allow the game access to your folders in order for your save data to migrate correctly

Happy Broccoli Team

notes.title: IS IT HOT IN HERE? COS THIS DUCK IS ON FIRE!
notes.notes:
Hello detectives,

We are positively overwhelmed by the overwhelming positive rating of The Ghost of Glamping with a 99% rating in under a week!

Wow, you guys really like ducks!

Thank you so much to everyone who has quacked the case! It's been a blast watching streams, reading people's discussions over in the forums, and seeing such awesome fan art

We are planning a third duck detective game, but for now we're taking a break from Eugene to work on a different game. We want to make sure every Duck Detective case is a superb mystery, which is why we'll be taking some extra time for the next one!

Check out this fantastic art by [url=https://www.instagram.com/ogaelfox/?igsh=dnkyZnBrZmduZTZl&utm_source=qr]Victoria Luberda[/url] of Eugene's latest case:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340541/0b9c087905b1f4078e2cc93237cebea9936235e8.jpg[/img]

We're also excited to announce that we've partnered up with some of the finest detective games, including: Tangle Tower, Return of the Obra Dinn, The Roottrees are Dead, and The Rise of the Golden Idol in a bundle you can check out here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54270/Cerebral_Puzzle_Detectives/ 

Once again, a really huge thank you to every single duck and detective enthusiast,

~ Happy Broccoli Team

notes.title: The Ghost of Glamping is out now!!
notes.notes:
The Ghost of Glamping is out now!!

Fedoras at the ready! Polish your magnifying glass! Iron that long, sweeping trench coat! Our new Duck Detective game is out now, a brand new standalone no-murder mystery adventure. With CAMPING! 

Check out the launch trailer below…!

[previewyoutube=5ZcBzH9TmSg;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s been so much fun returning to this world and we’re so excited for you to all dive back into the pond with us. As well as a whole new case, The Ghost of Glamping includes an expanded, fully voice acted cast and a helpful (?) sidekick to assist The Detective in his famous de-duck-tions. 

Good luck feeding the beak of lady Justice! And if you like it, please don’t forget to leave a nice review! <3 

Merry solving!

~Happy Broccoli Team

notes.title: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping is releasing in May!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Just swinging around to let you know some AMAZING news - we have a release date for Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping! It’ll be out on May 22nd. 

Here’s the final trailer before launch..!

[previewyoutube=N6TF7hFYQqw;full][/previewyoutube]

This is a stand-alone adventure taking place in the same universe as Duck Detective: The Secret Salami. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve a no-murder mystery in a haunted luxury glampsite!! 

As well as a new setting and fully-voiced cast, the Ghost of Glamping also introduces Freddy as the new partner for the Detective, much to his annoyance. Work together to unravel the truth and nibble on the crumbs of justice!

~Happy Broccoli Team

notes.title: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping free demo out now!
notes.notes:
Hi Detectives! 🔍

It’s the moment you’ve all been waiting for… the Ghost of Glamping demo is finally available to play!

Meet the Duck Detective’s new sidekick, Freddy! Explore their messy apartment for clues! And embark on a super spooky outdoor adventure at a haunted glampsite!

The Ghost of Glamping has the same logic puzzle formula as the first Duck Detective game, but it’s a little more ambitious in scope. And, dare I say, a little spookier too (!?). The demo is 30-40 mins long and gives a good taste of what’s to come. If you have time please have a play and let us know what you think!

All the best,
Team Happy Broccoli 🥦

notes.title: New cozy mystery game, Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping!
notes.notes:
Hi investigators!

After months of secret work, we finally announced our newest game!!! Introducing Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping, a no-murder mystery adventure set on a (haunted??) luxury campsite. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and waddle your way to the truth!

[previewyoutube=YSen3srIrHQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We launched the first Duck Detective game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2637990/]Duck Detective: The Secret Salami[/url], earlier this year, and were amazed by the love and support we received. We couldn’t wait to get stuck in with another Eugene McQuacklin mystery. Obviously we’d love you to check out The Secret Salami, but don’t worry if you haven’t yet. These adventures can be played in any order!


The Ghost of Glamping is due to launch next year. We can’t get into exact dates yet, so please be sure to follow us here and on social media for updates.

See you soon!

All the best,

Happy Broccoli team <3
